newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yoshiya issues new shrs to fund purchase.
newsitem.headline: Yoshiya issues new shrs to fund purchase.

text.p: Yoshiya International Corp Ltd said on Monday it would issue 18.81 million new shares, or 5.87 percent of the enlarged share capital, at HK$1.01 each to third party Keber Ltd to fund the purchase of property.

The property concern said it had agreed to buy the entire issued share capital of Jet Asia Development Ltd from Keber for HK$19 million. It said the purchase would be settled by an issue of new shares to Keber.
Jet Air's principal asset is two shops in the Wing Wah Building and Yuen Wah Building in Tak Man Street in the Kowloon area of Hong Kong, it said.
Yoshiya shares were up one cent to HK$1.03 in afternoon trade.
